title: Everything you need to know about the water electrolyse - novice
tileDesc: Everything you need to know about basics for hydrogen production through water electrolysis.
overview:
Water electrolysis for hydrogen  production is widely used in ecological transition. It represents a potential clean vector to progressively replace fossile fuels.
In this beginner-oriented training course, you will learn the electrochemical fundamentals required to understand hydrogen production. You will then have the opportunity to observe a simplified hydrogen production system in operation, allowing you to identify the constraints associated with this production method, potential areas for improvement, and its current limitations. You will leave with a training booklet summarizing the key concepts covered during the course, along with a few exercises to reinforce your understanding.
objectives:
- electrochemistry basics required for water hydrolysis understanding
- identifying constraints, improvement axis and limits intrinsic to this method
